_readme: Trips that were ticked 'she went' but that the captions plainly contradict.
These are kept out of the map. The tick is left alone in travel-verdicts.json,
so nothing is lost and putting one back is a one-line delete from this file.
Every one of these is a post made in Dubai about a product, a shop or a gift
that happens to carry a country's name. That is the same trap that put Sri Lanka
and Japan in the list. A map going in front of hotels cannot carry them.

excluded.why: Dior's 'Dioriviera' collection launch, a range inspired by the French Riviera. A beauty post, not a trip to France.
Forest Essentials, an Indian brand, opening in Dubai Hills Mall and Mirdiff City Centre. She is in Dubai.
A Modista shopping event in Dubai. Nothing in the post puts her in Switzerland.
'No1 does winter wear like DELHI GIRLS' with the tag #dubaiwinters. She is in Dubai talking about Delhi.
An outfit post. The only Thai thing in it is a bag someone brought her back as a gift.
